_comment: Task 1.9 (frontier). The nine worlds have periods of 20 to 180 days in exact 1:2:...:9 ratios.

systems.name: The Orrery
systems.notes: Nine worlds circle a single Absent structure. A red dwarf several light-hours away lights them faintly.

bodies.name: Central structure
bodies.class: dark Absent object the size of a small moon
bodies.notes: A single Absent structure, dark and about the size of a small moon, with no star at the center. It warms the nine worlds that circle it in exact resonance and is veined through with lattice.

bodies.name: Lamp (WIP)
bodies.notes: Red dwarf several light-hours from the central structure. It lights the nine worlds faintly; the structure warms them.

bodies.name: Pinion (WIP)
bodies.notes: One of the nine worlds of the Orrery, in exact resonance with the others: its year is exactly 1 times that of the innermost world.

bodies.name: Arbor (WIP)
bodies.class: dim fungal world warmed by the structure
bodies.notes: One of the nine worlds of the Orrery, in exact resonance with the others: its year is exactly 2 times that of the innermost world.

bodies.name: Pallet (WIP)
bodies.notes: One of the nine worlds of the Orrery, in exact resonance with the others: its year is exactly 3 times that of the innermost world.

bodies.name: Ratchet (WIP)
bodies.notes: One of the nine worlds of the Orrery, in exact resonance with the others: its year is exactly 4 times that of the innermost world.

bodies.name: Detent (WIP)
bodies.notes: One of the nine worlds of the Orrery, in exact resonance with the others: its year is exactly 5 times that of the innermost world.

bodies.name: Mainspring (WIP)
bodies.notes: One of the nine worlds of the Orrery, in exact resonance with the others: its year is exactly 6 times that of the innermost world.

bodies.name: Balance (WIP)
bodies.notes: One of the nine worlds of the Orrery, in exact resonance with the others: its year is exactly 7 times that of the innermost world.

bodies.name: Fusee (WIP)
bodies.notes: One of the nine worlds of the Orrery, in exact resonance with the others: its year is exactly 8 times that of the innermost world.

bodies.name: Escapement (WIP)
bodies.notes: One of the nine worlds of the Orrery, in exact resonance with the others: its year is exactly 9 times that of the innermost world.

bodies.name: Survey Office station
bodies.notes: The Survey Office's research station, studying the structure and the resonance. Survey crews report that the alignment of the nine worlds is never quite the same from one visit to the next, though every orbit measures as perfectly stable.

bodies.name: Orison mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the 11-day lane to Orison (drifting: its exit point wanders and a recent chart is needed).

bodies.name: Shoals mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the 6-day lane to the Shoals (tidal: open about two weeks in every seventy-three days).

places.name: Lattice veins (WIP)
places.notes: Where survey crews have sampled the lattice that veins the structure through and through. Nobody has mined it.

places.name: Arbor survey camp (WIP)
places.notes: Survey camp studying Arbor's fungal life.
